Your physical presence can communicate more than words. Simply being there — sitting in silence, offering a hug, or holding their hand — can bring immense comfort.

Active listening is essential. Allow the grieving person to express their feelings without interruption. Sometimes, the greatest support you can give is a listening ear.

Offer to accompany them to a grief counselor or therapist. Professional guidance can provide tools for coping and navigating through the pain.

Together, honor the memory of their loved one by creating a space where cherished memories and mementos can be displayed. This physical reminder honors the life that was lived and can bring comfort.

Grief is a long journey, not a sprint. Reaffirm your support consistently with phone calls, visits, and written messages. Letting the grieving person know they are continually in your thoughts can be a powerful lifeline.
